# Xelthia
## Gameplay Information
[color=#00cc00][bold]Positives:[/bold][/color]
- Due to having tentacles, are able to drop and regrow their arms as needed; dropped arms can be eaten if desired. - Have a higher-than-average heat tolerance, and take [color=#ffa500]less Heat damage[/color] overall. - Have slippery, [color=#bbff00]Acidic blood[/color]. - Immune to most sources of [color=#bbff00]Caustic damage[/color]. - Can eat raw food without any negative consequences, and don't suffer a theobromine allergy.
[color=red][bold]Negatives:[/bold][/color]
- Carnivores; can only eat foods containing meat. - Thanks to having tentacles for arms, they [color=red]can't wear gloves[/color]. If you want [color=yellow]electrical insulation[/color], you'll have to track down an [color=yellow]insulated jacket[/color]! - Have worse-than average cold tolerance, and take more [color=#1e90ff]Cold damage[/color] overall.
## Background Information Their first contact with humans was around 2754, almost one hundred years ago. They tend to be foodies, and aren't fans of wasting things, going as far with it as to often eat their own dead— even raw.
Your species, the Xelthia, come from a semi-aquatic world of warm black seas and shallow, mineral-rich swamps. Their planet, Ocetii, is covered in thick fog and low gravity, with long tidal flats where land and water constantly overlap. Early Xelthia evolved in brine pools filled with sharp crystals and toxic algae. To survive constant cuts and predators, their bodies developed acidic blood that slips others and burns most parasites on contact.
Their language began as pulses of color and high vibrations. After first contact, they learned to reproduce human speech by forcing air through a layered throat sac. The result is understandable but uneven, with strange pauses and high pitches between words.
Xelthia culture values adaptation over tradition. They do not keep permanent cities; instead, they grow and dissolve structures made of hardened secretions and woven sea-fiber. Your kind lack proper recorded history: they are curious about others, albeit a bit wary by default. You are typically solitary, only remaining near other Xelthia out of logical need.
